capabilities: Bind notes to media sources with timestamp-url blocks and insert clickable timestamps
Import .srt and .vtt subtitles and jump playback from subtitle lines
Resolve page links to direct stream URLs with yt-dlp for mobile playback
Manage saved media, subtitles, RSS podcasts, and media folders in a library sidebar
Record voice notes and run dictation practice against subtitle segments
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; yt-dlp is a desktop-only optional dependency, and some resolved direct links expire or may not be browser-playable.
motivation: The author wants video note-taking to feel native inside Obsidian, including on mobile, instead of switching to other apps.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to watch video or audio beside notes, link note positions to playback timestamps, or work with subtitles.

relations.evidence: This project builds on ObsidianTimestampNotes by @juliang22, then expands it

summary: Video and audio note-taking plugin that binds notes to media with clickable timestamps, imports subtitles, and adds a media library and mobile timestamp rail.
